title: Kilimanjaro and Safari in One Trip
excerpt: After the summit, a safari is the perfect way to recover. Here is how to combine Kilimanjaro with the Serengeti, Ngorongoro and Tarangire.
body:
Most people who fly to Tanzania for Kilimanjaro also want to see the animals. Fortunately, Kilimanjaro and the northern parks are close together.

## Climb first, then safari

We almost always plan the climb first. After the mountain your legs want rest, and a safari is mainly sitting in a vehicle, watching. It is the perfect recovery.

## A sample combination

- Day 1: arrival at Kilimanjaro Airport, night in Moshi.
- Day 2–9: [Lemosho Route](/blog/kilimanjaro-lemosho-route-guide/), eight days.
- Day 10: rest in Arusha.
- Day 11: [Tarangire](/blog/tarangire-national-park-guide/).
- Day 12–13: [Serengeti](/blog/serengeti-national-park-guide/).
- Day 14: [Ngorongoro Crater](/blog/ngorongoro-crater-guide/), back to Arusha.
- Day 15: departure.

## Luggage

Your climbing gear can stay at the hotel in Arusha during the safari. On a safari you need light, neutral clothing.

## Time

If you have less time, a three-day safari to Tarangire and Ngorongoro works too. See [a three-day safari](/blog/short-safari-3-days/).

## The beach as well?

Add a few days on [Zanzibar](/blog/kilimanjaro-and-zanzibar/) for the perfect mountain, bush and beach trip.

[Plan your Kilimanjaro and safari trip](/travel-proposal/).
